source_hash_policy: SHA256 of LF-normalized UTF-8 source; avoids checkout conversion differences.
historical_identity: Both original wrappers equal the frozen source snapshot; eight existing kernel/benchmark/result paths unchanged, verified in the suite.

boundary.cpu_tensors: Tiny real CPU fallback cases, not a model evaluation.
boundary.cuda_inputs: Tensor metadata mocks and fake pointer/launch callbacks; not CUDA/GPU correctness.

device_context_policy: Current CuPy device must match tensor metadata; never switch context. First accepted device binds the existing process-wide function/module cache under a lock; later device changes fail closed.
